summary: # **CENTRAL ELECTRICITY REGULATORY COMMISSION NEW DELHI** ## ** Petition No. 263/TT/2025 ** **Coram:** **Shri Jishnu Barua, Chairperson Shri Ramesh Babu V., Member Shri Harish Dudani, Member Shri Ravinder Singh Dhillon, Member** **Date of Order: 17.09.2026** **In the matter of:** Corrigendum to the order dated 8.12.2025 in Petition No. 263/TT/2025. ## **And** **In the matter of:** Petition for the determination of the transmission tariff under Section 62 read with Section 79(1)(d) of the Electricity Act, 2003 and under Regulations 15(1)(a) and 23 of the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Conduct of Business) Regulations, 2023 read with the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Terms and Conditions of Tariff) Regulations, 2024 for Augmentation of the 1x500 MVA, 400/220 kV ICT (3rd) at Raigarh (PG) along with associated ICT bays under the “Augmentation of Transformation Capacity by 1x500 MVA, 400/220 kV ICT (3rd) at the Raigarh (PG) Substation”. ## **And** **In the matter of:** **Power Grid Corporation of India Limited,** Saudamini, Plot No - 2, Sector - 29, Gurgaon-122001 (Haryana). **...Petitioner** ## **Versus** 1. **Madhya Pradesh Power Management Company Limited,** Shakti Bhawan, Rampur, Jabalpur-482008; **and 7 Others. Respondent(s)** ## ** CORRIGENDUM ORDER ** Certain inadvertent error has crept into the Commission’s order dated 8.12.2025 in Petition No. 263/TT/2025, and this error is corrected/rectified as follows, in exercise of the Corrigendum Order in Petition No. 263/TT/2025 Page **1** of **2** powers under Regulation 54 read with Regulation 66 of the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Conduct of Business) Regulations, 2023. Accordingly, after the end of the last sentence of paragraph 39, the following sentence shall be added: _“However, the Petitioner is at liberty to raise the issue of admissibility of IDC with updated information, at the time of truing up of the transmission tariff for the 2024-29 tariff period, in accordance with law”.’_ 2. Except for the above, all other terms and directions contained in the order dated - 8.12.2025 in Petition No. 263/TT/2025 shall remain unaltered. **sd/- sd/- sd/- sd/(Ravinder Singh Dhillon) (Harish Dudani) (Ramesh Babu V.) (Jishnu Barua) Member Member Member Chairperson** CERC Website S. No. 467/2026 Corrigendum Order in Petition No. 263/TT/2025 Page **2** of **2**
